## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The adoption path should preserve unchanged settings instead of reporting and writing them as changes.

## Changes
The pull request adds an `adopt` flag to the settings merger and tests adoption and replacement of different values.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/config.py:15 — correctness — Skip unchanged values during adoption — With `{"theme":"dark"}` already stored, your `merge(path, {"theme":"dark"}, adopt=True)` returns `["theme"]` and rewrites the file. The unconditional append bypasses the equality check used by replacement, violating the module’s untouched-file preservation contract. — Users lose existing formatting and incur unnecessary configuration writes when adopting settings that already match. — Fix: Apply the equality check during adoption and extend `test_unchanged_replacement_preserves_bytes` to cover adoption.
